# Control Center apply consistency: evidence

Captured on the maintainer's real host (Hyprland, 1920x1080) with `grim`, cropped to the Settings window.
Each shows the shared "Applied · Undo" strip right after a change that applied by itself.

- `chromatic-applied-undo.png`: Chromatic variant chosen, no Apply button; strip "All set · Chromatic palette".
- `theme-day-applied-undo.png`: a light theme applied from the Themes list; the strip in a light palette.
- `layout-applied-undo.png`: Floating Island layout applied; Undo restores `shell.json` byte for byte.
